integrity: Claims rely on a stated formal proof and independently executable finite tests. No independent human or mathematical certification has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Only A=F_q[x,y]/(x^2,y^n), n>=2, is studied. Finite checker exhausts twelve finite configurations; the general rank law follows from Smith invariants. An older equivalent formula is not categorically excluded. Jordan degree types and arbitrary two-variable complete intersections are not classified.
title: Valuation-stratified Jordan census in a two-variable Artinian complete intersection
